# discord_guilds (Data Source)

Lists the guilds the configured bot/user is a member of.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_guilds" "mine" {}

output "guild_names" {
  value = [for g in data.discord_guilds.mine.guilds : g.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `guilds` (Attributes List) The guilds the current user is in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guilds))

<a id="nestedatt--guilds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guilds`

Read-Only:

- `icon` (String) Guild icon hash.
- `id` (String) Guild snowflake ID.
- `name` (String) Guild name.
- `owner` (Boolean) Whether the current user owns the guild.
